title: Grateful Dead Live at Compton Terrace Amphitheatre on 1982-07-25
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi Dragon > ART DI/O > Digital Audio Labs Card Deluxe soundcard > Cool Edit 2000 > flac encoding > FLAC

ai_review.summary: Stellar summer‑1982 performance with smoking Estimated Prophet and Franklin’s Tower, captured on an amazingly clear audience recording.
ai_review.review: The show is praised as one of the top dates of the 1982 tour, delivering high‑energy playing throughout both sets with standout renditions of Estimated Prophet and Franklin’s Tower. The audience tape is described as “out of this world,” offering an immersive listening experience despite a few minor guitar hiccups.

ai_rating.rationale: All five reviews are highly favorable (four 5‑star, one 4‑star) and consistently highlight both an excellent performance and superb audience recording quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners repeatedly note the tape’s immersive, crystal‑clear sound that makes you feel ‘there’; no significant dropouts or muddiness are reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Both sets flow tightly with high‑octane energy, keeping the momentum hot from start to finish.

band_member_comments.Jerry: A few verses of Franklin's Tower were fumbled, but his overall guitar work remains strong and fuels the show’s intensity.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent (keyboards) shines on the instrumental sections, especially during the Franklin's Tower jam.
